name: FUN_WF_PATTERNS
description: This table contains data related to patterns used in approval rules configuration.

columns.name: PATTERN_ID
columns.description: Pattern identifier and primary key.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference identifier to the FUN_WF_RULES table.

columns.name: PATTERN_ORDER
columns.description: The order in which patterns are stored for a rule in the rule file.

columns.name: PARENT_PATTERN_ID
columns.description: Reference to the parent pattern when approval rules are having nested patterns.

columns.name: FACT_PATH
columns.description: Path joining multiple child patterns.

columns.name: FORM_CODE
columns.description: Type of pattern indicating whether the rules are configures using nested conditions.

columns.name: PATTERN_VARIABLE
columns.description: Variable name to identify the fact used within the pattern.

columns.name: FACT_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the fact used in the pattern.

columns.name: FACT_TYPE_KEY
columns.description: Fully qualified fact name as defined in the rule file.

columns.name: CONNECTIVE_OPERATOR
columns.description: Operator symbol connecting the pattern to the next pattern in the order. Possible values are && and II.

columns.name: TEST_FORM_CODE
columns.description: Type of the rule condition associated with the pattern.

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: Surround operator symbol used in the pattern as part of rule configuration. Possible values are && and II.

columns.name: AGGREGATE_VARIABLE
columns.description: Variable name defined for aggregate surround by operator.

columns.name: AGGREGATE_FUNCTION
columns.description: Name of the aggregate function.

columns.name: AGGREGATE_EXPRESSION
columns.description: Attribute expression that is being aggregated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
